Ex-Minister Accused of Funnelling Municipality Funds into Businesses

The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has accused former West Bengal minister Sujit Bose of diverting funds from a municipality scam into his personal businesses, including a restaurant, bar, and flats. The ED's allegations detail the alleged funneling of these funds into his hospitality ventures. This development involves an investigation into financial irregularities linked to the municipality.
